brief:
New York City Mayor Eric Adams denounced Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as a war criminal and architect of genocide, according to Maan Wire. Adams's statement marks an escalation in rhetoric from the city's chief executive regarding Israel's military operations.

The characterization represents a significant shift in the language used by a major U.S. city leader toward the Israeli government, moving beyond criticism of specific policies to accusations of fundamental crimes under international law.

title: New York Mayor Calls Netanyahu War Criminal and Genocide Architect
